name: Feature test runs
description: Watches the end-to-end feature suite (launcher, windows, apps, companion, stylist, tray, settings, terminal, boot: 12 VM runs, about an hour) live: pass/fail per run and design, the run in progress, and the errors in each run's serial log.
agent: Use after every build of the Operating System tree instead of running scripts/feature-checks.sh by hand: tests_start (optionally only some runs), tests_status while it runs, tests_details for a failed run's checks, errors and log tail.
